description: Erection of a terrace with privacy screen and balustrade on rear first floor flat roof
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (9708/ EX-00, 9708/ EX-01, 9708/ EX-02, 9708/ EX-03, 9708/ EX-04, 9708/ PL 2 - 01, 9708/ PL 2 - 02, 9708/ PL 2 - 03, 9708/ PL 2 - 04 received 5 October 2021; 9708/ PL 2 - 05, Fire Strategy received  12 October 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the balustrade shall be stainless steel standards with a glass infill.

Condition : 4 - Before the extension hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a 1.75 metre high obscure glazed privacy screen shall be installed on the southern elevation accordance with a the submitted plans  and be retained as such thereafter.
